issues.body: The new row sets `gate_profile = "node-workspace"`, but `scripts/policy-resolve.py` accepts only `none`, `lint-only`, `crate-scoped`, `workspace`, and `registry-selftest`, and `scripts/worker-live.sh` has no `node-workspace` gate branch. The row escapes that validation only because `_policy_row` rejects disabled targets before validating their remaining fields. Consequently the documented follow-up of flipping only `enabled` to true will fail closed during policy resolution rather than onboard the target. The comment that the target's existing `gate` check makes this profile valid does not create a resolver/worker implementation.
issues.fix_hint: Use an existing gate profile whose worker behavior is correct for this repository, or add and non-vacuously test a complete `node-workspace` implementation across the resolver, worker gate, and schema documentation. Validate the staged row with `enabled=true` in a test so the promised one-line activation is proven before merge.
issues.title: The staged target uses an unsupported gate profile

issues.body: `probe_repo = sorted(_enabled_rows)[0]` deterministically selects `jeswr/agent-account-registry`, which the immediately preceding shipped-policy assertion already requires to contain `review_enrolment_authors = ["jeswr"]`. Assigning `["jeswr"]` again does not change the fixture. The check therefore remains green if the intended empty-to-enrolled probe setup is removed, and it cannot support the comment that the reader "WOULD surface one" for an un-enrolled row. This is the value-identical mutation failure mode called out by the repository pre-flight rules.
issues.fix_hint: Select a known enabled, un-enrolled row (currently `sparq-org/sparq`), assert its baseline reader result is empty, mutate that same row to a sentinel canonical login not present in shipped policy, and assert the reader returns that sentinel. Avoid deriving the expected value from production policy constants.
issues.title: The positive enrolment probe is value-identical and vacuous

verdict.summary: The disabled target is safely inert today, but the submitted staging is not complete enough for the documented one-line enablement: `node-workspace` is not a supported policy or worker gate profile. The accompanying self-test edit also retains a value-identical positive probe, so it does not establish the transition its comment claims. Both defects are directly in changed lines and require correction before approval.
